concept:
Use case: stylized-concept. Paint a premium environment-only backdrop for a VALORANT fan portfolio, in the official VALORANT painted map loading-screen / environment key-art aesthetic: confident bold planar silhouettes, beautifully controlled clean gradients, hard-edged brush-painted architectural planes, sophisticated economical detail, dramatic graphic composition. One portrait-ish 8:9 painting, target 1600x1800. NO text, letters, logos, emblems, UI, border, people or characters.
SCENE: looking from a Venetian rooftop across an Ascent-inspired Italian plaza at NIGHT. Terracotta roofs, elegant arcade arches, stucco planes and a tall narrow Italian campanile spire left of centre (x=32%, tip y=27%). In the upper-left-to-centre distance a magnificent floating fragment of Italian city / radianite island: dark angular inverted rock slabs, a few small floating shards, glowing pale coral-white fissure and restrained atmospheric light. Not a spaceship. The spire is grounded in the city. Layered city descends from left edge toward a simple misty open plaza at centre-right. A few city windows lit warm off-white. Long diagonal architectural shadows and tiny suspended dust flecks in glowing air. Deep garnet-to-red-black sky above, hot coral red glow close to horizon. Restrict entire painting to red, coral, warm cream/off-white and near-black, NO blue, purple, teal, green or yellow. Red is the dominant hue.
COMPOSITION FOR AGENT OVERLAY: put architectural interest mostly at left and bottom; preserve a broad uncluttered smooth red midtone area x=52–88%, y=18–76% behind the future agent, low contrast in that area. No bright sun disc, no giant moon. Right edge can have a very low distant roof, not a large tower. Top-right should stay simple for a radar overlay. The bottom 18% is a sharply drawn dark rooftop terrace/parapet, angular coping ledge sweeps from lower-left down toward lower centre with a low flat right edge, one restrained geometric ventilation housing at bottom-left. Do not put foreground architecture in the upper half. Clear separation of sky, distant architecture, foreground roof. Cinematic depth without photographic detail. Visually arresting like Riot's premium environment illustration, not a generic fantasy castle, not line art, not an overly noisy digital painting.

layers.prompt: Edit target: the supplied environment concept. Produce its SKY BACKGROUND PLATE ONLY for a layered game environment. Remove absolutely all architecture, floating islands, rocks, spires, buildings, rooftops, foreground walls, plaza and props, replacing their pixels with continuous painted sky. Keep the original framing, portrait 8:9 aspect, composition and red-black NIGHT lighting. Entire image is opaque sky: deep garnet-black above, flowing sculpted red clouds along left, smooth quiet wine-red across centre-right, warm glowing coral haze along bottom. No sun or moon. Preserve existing cloud shapes where visible; invent matching continuation behind removed buildings. Official Valorant painted-key-art feel: broad clean graphic brush planes and controlled gradients. Red / near-black / off-white palette only. No blue, yellow, purple. No objects, text, logos or people. Final 1600x1800 target.

Edit target: supplied environment painting. Extract ONLY the complete distant environment as ONE TRANSPARENT PNG LAYER on the identical portrait 8:9 canvas: all Venetian architecture, the tall campanile, plaza with empty central monument, floating city island and tiny floating rock shards. Remove the entire sky to real transparent alpha including all holes between island/rocks/tower/rooftops. Also remove ONLY the nearest black rooftop foreground parapet and ventilation box (bottom 18%, box at bottom-left) to real transparency. Keep all distant city architecture behind that removed parapet, extend the city/plaza naturally down to the bottom edge as hidden overscan, so parallax won't expose holes. Preserve overall positions and shapes of architecture, floating island and spire. Keep NIGHT lighting: dark red planes, coral rim light, cream lit windows and glowing red-white fissures. Refine to official VALORANT map concept art: slightly broader graphic planes, crisp faceted edges, restrained painted details, not photoreal. No black backdrop, no sky, no ground shadow outside objects. True transparent alpha, no checkerboard baked in. No people/characters, no lettering/logos. Target full canvas 1600x1800, don't crop to content.

Edit target: supplied environment painting. Extract ONLY the NEAREST FOREGROUND ROOFTOP as one transparent PNG plate on the exact same full portrait 8:9 canvas. Keep ONLY the large bottom-left black ventilation housing, nearest diagonal stone parapet ledge starting at left y~72% and sloping down to centre y~84%, low flat right-hand parapet, nearest tiled terrace floor in bottom strip. All visible sky and every distant city building, spire, floating island, plaza and tree must become true transparent alpha. Upper ~62% entirely empty transparency; foreground only in bottom band apart from left ventilation box starting at y~62%. Preserve exact original positions and perspective, do not centre or enlarge the object. Dark ink-black red stone with sparse coral light on upper coping, dramatic angular planes in official Valorant painted-key-art style. No backdrop, no checkerboard, no fake transparency. No people, text or logos. Full canvas target 1600x1800.
